hook: GREAT ACTORS REALLY CRY|THEN THEY HEAR CUT

voices.name: l00
voices.text: A good actor <#0.2#> really cries in a sad scene.
voices.caption: A good actor really cries in a sad scene.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: But when they hear cut, <#0.3#> they come back to themselves.
voices.caption: But when they hear cut, they come back to themselves.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: They experienced the role. <#0.2#> They didn't become it.
voices.caption: They experienced the role. They didn't become it.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Next time you're angry, <#0.2#> don't say, I'm angry.
voices.caption: Next time you're angry, don't say, I'm angry.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Say, anger is passing <#0.2#> through me right now.
voices.caption: Say, anger is passing through me right now.
